body.name: bconst
body.def: Let \(K_{\mathrm{const}}=\begin{psmallmatrix}\Omega&A\\A^{\prime}&0\end{psmallmatrix}\) and define \(\binom{b^{\mathrm{const}}}{\lambda_{\mathrm{const}}}=K_{\mathrm{const}}^{\dagger}\binom{0}{\omega}\). Equivalently, \(b^{\mathrm{const}}\) is the minimum-Euclidean-norm member of \(\arg\min_{A^{\prime}b=\omega}b^{\prime}\Omega b\).
